nodes.label: No-Build MCP Cold Registration
nodes.description: Stepwise plan makes a committed manifest the MCP tool authority and uses a dependency-free stdio shim to answer initialize and tools/list without synchronously invoking Cargo.

nodes.label: Manifest-to-Translator Bijection
nodes.description: A test requires every manifest tool to have one translation function and every translation entry to appear in the manifest, preventing silent registration drift.

nodes.label: Cold-Shim Proxy Handoff Protocol
nodes.description: When the real binary appears, the shim should replay captured initialization state and proxy subsequent JSON-RPC; until then tool calls return a retryable building error without spawning Cargo.

edges.description: The bijection test protects the committed manifest used during cold registration.
The shim's handoff preserves the client session once the binary becomes available.
